title: Review of the thermals flow-heredity finding on fresh seeds 37 and 38: daughters keep the planted kind at 234/236 splits, no conversions, and the 10% yield advantage fixes kind a on both seeds (1.0 vs 0.08 and 0.15 in the neutral twin)
summary: Ran the author's heredity.py (labkit segmentation and tracker on 1 t frames, T=800) on fresh seeds 37 and 38 at eps +0.1 and eps 0, and a labkit pack at eps +0.1 on seed 37. Daughters keep the parent's kind at 74/74 and 75/76 (eps 0.1) and 40/40 and 45/46 (eps 0) persistent splits after labelling; 0 conversions among 197-237 tracks alive >= 20 t; median cap purity 0.90-0.96. Kind a goes from 10:12 and 8:2 (a:b at t=205) to 32:0 and 31:0 at t=800 with eps +0.1, and from 10:10 and 9:2 to 2:24 and 4:22 in the neutral twin.

observations.H: heredity/h_s37_e0.1.json and h_s38_e0.1.json: daughter_agree 74/74 and 75/76, conversions 0; kind counts a:b 10:12 -> 32:0 and 8:2 -> 31:0 (t=205 -> 800). Neutral twin h_s37_e0.json and h_s38_e0.json: 40/40 and 45/46, 0 conversions, 10:10 -> 2:24 and 9:2 -> 4:22. rerun_eps0.1_s37/sheet.png shows the labelled caps rising and splitting.

seeds_run.result: pass: fidelity 74/74, a fixes (32:0) vs neutral 2:24
pass: fidelity 75/76, a fixes (31:0) vs neutral 4:22

controls_run.H: heredity/h_s37_e0.json, h_s38_e0.json (eps 0, same seeds and labelling)

verdicts.limitation: As the finding says, the kinds are planted at t=200 by half-box labelling and the label sets the heat yield directly; the neutral twin drifts strongly (seed 38: a goes from 9:2 to 4:22), so with two kinds and ~30 caps, single-seed shares say little and the sign test across seeds carries the result. I ran only eps +0.1, not the sign-reversed arm, and no dt/2 or resolution variant.
